title: Rust: Enforce max slot claim duration in verify_slot_claim
description:
Add expiry duration check to rust/lichen-link/src/trust.rs verify_slot_claim():

After signature verification, check:
- claim.expiry <= now_unix + MAX_CLAIM_DURATION_SEC

Return SlotClaimResult variant for expiry-too-far rejection.

Needs now_unix parameter added to verify_slot_claim() or a time provider trait.

Add test case.

Ref: project-LICHEN-worker6-70p7
